master_rules.logo_location: Slide Master or Slide Layout ONLY
master_rules.editability: slide-specific content in native PPT objects
master_rules.backgrounds: full-slide approved PNG in layout; no baked text/logo
master_rules.charts: native chart objects and theme palette

cover.content_region: right two-thirds intended text space; focal flare placement decided by Claude

section.title_zone: place chapter/title in deliberate relation to focal light streak; Claude determines exact typography and coordinates

content.content_region: white body below the header for body material; header banner reserved for title

notes: Do not treat prototype coordinates and type sizes as formal design specs.
PowerPoint layout and typography specifications are the responsibility of Claude, informed by CIS and approved visual references.
Visual accents / flares should meaningfully emphasize titles rather than being disconnected decoration.

delegated: font sizes and type scale within CIS
using light flares, diagonal lines and visual focal points
content density, layout composition, diagram design, chart styles
hard_constraints: use approved imagery unmodified unless user approves revision
cover artwork occupies approximately left 1/3, leave right 2/3 for copy
content page top banner is the title zone; do not default its title to the white body
content page white body stays uncluttered
official logo via master/layout, not repeated per slide
respect CIS v3.2 brand colors and font families
designer_authority.note: These are user-approved intentions, not fixed coordinate/point-size recipes. The final layout system is to be authored and tested by Claude.
